summary: The restart construction omits caller-side projection, close-owner rebind, and common lifecycle quiescence obligations.

findings.title: Restart omits projection-commit, close rebind, and shared lifetime quiescence
findings.remediation: Commit recovered vertices through the existing room commit path, rebind creator-close on genesis recovery, and serialize recovery on the same lifetime transition owner as close/adopt.
